product_one_liner.value: AmplifAI is an AI-powered contact-center performance and customer-experience platform that unifies interaction and workforce data, automates quality evaluation, and guides coaching for contact-center teams.
product_one_liner.notes: The product is presented for contact centers and CX teams.

pricing_page.notes: The homepage navigation/footer has no pricing link or public prices; pricing is handled through sales/demo contact.

named_customers.notes: Sonic Automotive is the named customer in a customer success story; iQor is explicitly identified as selecting AmplifAI.

employee_band.notes: LinkedIn lists a 51–200 range; Built In lists 62 total employees, which places it in the requested 51–100 band.

hq_location.notes: Company address is in Plano, Texas.

founded_year.notes: The company's 2025 funding announcement says the company was founded in 2018; some third-party profiles conflict, so the company-source disclosure is used.

eng_blog.notes: The blog index includes marketing, product, research, and customer-service AI content; no two posts about engineering implementation by engineers are evident.

public_docs.notes: The navigation and footer do not list product documentation, a developer portal, or help center.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The careers page/job listing shows a Senior .Net Full Stack Developer role, not an AI/ML/data-science role by title.

model_provider.notes: Reviewed the available blog and Trust/Security information; no AI model or model provider is publicly identified.

compliance_certs.notes: All five are explicitly listed on the company's Trust and Compliance page.

last_funding.notes: The company announced a $33.7 million Series B funding and credit facility on September 23, 2025.

raised_18mo.notes: September 2025 falls within the 18 months before November 9, 2026.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The available company job posting is a full-stack developer role; no SDR, BDR, sales/business development representative, or account executive opening is shown.

launched_6mo.notes: The blog/search result reports the AmplifAI 3.0 product announcement in November 2026, within the six-month window; its specific dated announcement is not supplied on the page.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: The leadership page lists current executives but does not establish their join dates or verify departures in the 12-month window.

crm_stack_signal.notes: These CRM systems are specifically named on the integrations page.
